display.purpose: ACOCOS wordmark on the login page — the one place with room for character.

body.purpose: All UI text, rows, and table cells.

label.purpose: Field labels, metric labels, panel titles, table headers.

money.purpose: The 22px tabular total on the money bar — the typographic signature.

shadows.name: ambient-lift
shadows.purpose: The single shadow token. Floats truly-detached surfaces: cards, the money bar, the chart tooltip. Never paired with a prominent border as decoration.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one shared easing so /pos/ and the dashboard feel alike.

motion.name: dur-pos
motion.purpose: /pos/ transitions stay short — a client is waiting. Press affordance and HTMX-fragment fade only.

motion.name: dur-dash
motion.purpose: Dashboard is opened once or twice a day, so line-draw / bar-grow / count-up choreography is affordable.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single filled button per screen — «Подтвердить продажу» below the money bar.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0.5px solid #2C6FB5; border-radius: 8px; background: #2C6FB5; color: #fff; font: 500 15px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), background-color 120ms; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2C6FB5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions — undo, cancel. Transparent fill, accent text, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0.5px solid #E3E6E9; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #2C6FB5; font: 500 15px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2C6FB5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: 16px font-size prevents iOS auto-zoom; visible resting border in both themes.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Поиск товара или SKU">
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 0.5px solid #E3E6E9; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #14181C; font: 400 16px Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8A939C; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #2C6FB5; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2C6FB5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Colour + word, never colour alone. Variants: paid / partial / debt / neutral.
components.html: оплачено частично долг
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 20px; font: 500 11px Inter, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-paid { background: #E4F3EB; color: #1D7A4F; } .ds-badge-partial { background: #FBF0DE; color: #8A5300; } .ds-badge-debt { background: #FAE9E8; color: #B3271F; }

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: Dashboard KPI. Reserves 92px min-height so count-up never shifts layout. Border, no shadow.
components.html:
Выручка
1 240 500 сом
↑ 12% к прошлому периоду
components.css: .ds-metric { min-height: 92px; padding: 12px; border: 0.5px solid #E3E6E9; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; } .ds-metric__label { font: 400 11px Inter, sans-serif; color: #5B6670; } .ds-metric__value { margin-top: 2px; font: 500 19px Inter, sans-serif; color: #14181C; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-metric__delta { margin-top: 4px; font: 400 11px Inter, sans-serif; color: #1D7A4F; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Period Segmented Control
components.description: Dashboard period selector. Active pill filled accent; sunken trough.
components.css: .ds-period { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; background: #EDEFF1; border-radius: 20px; } .ds-period__pill { appearance: none; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #5B6670; font: 400 12px Inter, sans-serif; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 16px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-period__pill[aria-current="true"] { background: #2C6FB5; color: #fff; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Money Bar
components.description: The signature element. Sticky above the keyboard; Остаток carries the live payment-status colour. The 22px tabular total is the loudest text on the screen.
components.html:
Итого3 200 сом
Оплачено1 200 сом
Остаток · долг2 000 сом
components.css: .ds-money { background: #fff; border-top: 0.5px solid #E3E6E9; border-radius: 12px 12px 0 0; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(20,24,28,0.08); padding: 12px 16px; } .ds-money__row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; padding: 2px 0; font: 400 14px Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-money__amt { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-money__row--total { border-top: 0.5px solid #E3E6E9; margin-top: 4px; padding-top: 8px; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-money__row--debt { color: #B3271F; } .ds-money .ds-btn-primary { margin-top: 12px; }

narrative.overview: ACOCOS is read the way a pilot reads a cockpit: under time pressure, at a glance, with a client waiting at the counter. It is a tool touched roughly 50x a day on a phone, not a page anyone browses. Every visual decision serves one reading — what is the money doing right now? — and everything else recedes to make that reading instant. The signature is the pinned money bar, the largest text on the screen, in fixed-width digits so totals never jitter. A single chalk-blue accent does all the work of primary actions and selection, chosen precisely so it never competes with the reserved payment-status trio (green paid / amber partial / red debt). Surfaces are near-flat, borders are hairlines, depth is tonal not shadowed. Restraint here is not minimalism for its own sake; it is precision.
keyCharacteristics: Money is the loudest element on every screen; everything else is calibrated below it.
One accent, one filled button, hairline borders, tonal (not shadow) depth.
Tabular numerals wherever an amount appears — the typographic signature.
Colour + word for status, never colour alone (sunlight and colour-blindness both exist).
Mobile-first, thumb-sized (44px minimum), server-rendered, theme-aware with no flash.

rules.name: The Reserved Trio Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red belong to payment status and nothing else. Any new accent, chart series, or decorative colour is forbidden from those three hues.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: There is a single accent. Charts extend it as a monochrome ramp toward the surface; they never introduce new hues.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums is applied everywhere an amount appears, and only there.

rules.name: The 500 Ceiling Rule
rules.body: No weight above 500 anywhere. Emphasis comes from size, colour, and alignment.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 0.5px borders, not shadows and not 1px boxes. Shadows only lift things that are truly floating.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Layering is conveyed by the page/surface/sunken lightness ladder. If two surfaces need separating, step the tone.

dos: Do keep money the loudest element on every screen — 22px tabular total, semantic colour, pinned in view.
Do apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to every amount, and only to amounts.
Do pair every status colour with its word (оплачено / частично / долг).
Do draw structure with 0.5px hairline borders and the page/surface/sunken tonal ladder.
Do keep exactly one filled (accent) button per screen; everything else is ghost, link, or text.
Do read every colour, space, and radius from tokens.css as a var(); the token file is the only place a literal value is allowed.
Do give inputs and selects a visible resting border in both light and dark themes.
Do hold weights at 500 and below.
donts: Don't use green, amber, or red for anything but payment status.
Don't introduce a second accent or a rainbow chart palette; extend the one accent as a monochrome ramp.
Don't pair a 1px border with a soft wide drop shadow (the ghost-card pattern).
Don't over-round: cards top out at 12px, controls at 8px; the pill (20px) is for badges and chips only.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, decorative motion, or any weight above 500.
Don't treat this like a landing page — no hero, no marketing surface, no big-number-with-gradient hero-metric.
Don't draw in, stagger, or count up anything on /pos/ — save choreography for the once-a-day dashboard.
Don't hardcode a hex or px value outside tokens.css.
